Test Chamber Engineer

Remote, Lisbon

Aperture Science builds the chambers others only fall through. You will own
portal surface calibration from the first prototype to the last cake.

What you will do

Calibrate portal surfaces against the standard aperture

Keep the cake logistics pipeline honest

Review chamber designs for unintended exits

What we ask

Several years building something physical that had to work

A habit of writing down why, not only what

Apply for this job
